notes: Sourced from VITEC's own datasheet PDF, "VITEC_Ace_Decoder_Datasheet_23-Y.pdf" (Version 1.0, © VITEC 2022), fetched from vitec.com. This is the portable-appliance version of the MGW Ace Decoder (P/N 16647, "MGW Ace Decoder HD/SD," breakout cable included), which is single-channel, HEVC/H.264/MPEG-2, up to UHDp60 4:2:2 10-bit. A separate openGear card variant ("MGW Ace Decoder OG", P/N 17597) exists with a different rear I/O layout: SDI1-A/SDI1-B + SDI2 (2x 12G-SDI equivalent), HDMI, CVBS, DVB-ASI IN, a second Ethernet port, and a multi-pin AUDIO connector — it has no standalone power connector since it draws power from the openGear frame. Not modeled here. Most audio ports (AES3 BNC, RCA unbalanced, XLR balanced, talkback mini-jacks) and the Genlock/Serial signals are physically delivered through a single rear-panel "SERIAL / AUDIO / GENLOCK" multi-pin connector via an included breakout cable (P/N 16732); the datasheet gives the discrete signal/connector types (explicitly: 2x AES3 BNC female, 1x RCA female unbalanced stereo, 1x XLR male balanced stereo, mini-jack talkback in/out) but not the physical shape of the breakout connector itself on the chassis. The DC power connector shape (approximated here as xlr4-dc) and the exact serial standard (RS-232 vs RS-422) are inferred, not explicitly stated — lower confidence on just those two ports. Unit is compact/desktop (42.4 x 202 x 117.5 mm) with an optional 1RU 19" rack-mount kit, hence rackUnits set to 1.

ports.name: DVB-ASI IN
ports.note: DVB-ASI transport stream input with loop-through; not a video-grade SDI signal, no grade applies.

ports.name: SDI 2
ports.note: 3G/HD-SDI/SD-SDI, auto-rate (SMPTE 259M-C/292M/274M/296M/424M/425M-A); 3G is the highest supported rate on this port.

ports.name: CVBS
ports.note: Composite analog video output, BNC connector; not a digital SDI grade.

ports.name: Genlock In
ports.note: Reference sync input, reached via the rear-panel SERIAL/AUDIO/GENLOCK breakout connector and included breakout cable (P/N 16732); datasheet notes 'limitations apply'. Exact connector on the breakout leg inferred as BNC.

ports.name: Serial
ports.note: Control serial port on the SERIAL/AUDIO/GENLOCK breakout connector/cable. Datasheet does not state RS-232 vs RS-422 or the breakout connector shape — inferred as RS-232, low confidence on this specific port.

ports.name: AES3 Audio Out 1
ports.note: AES3 digital audio, BNC female, delivered via the SERIAL/AUDIO/GENLOCK breakout cable (device provides 2x AES3 BNC female outputs).

ports.name: AES3 Audio Out 2
ports.note: Second AES3 digital audio output, BNC female, via breakout cable.

ports.name: Analog Audio Out (Unbalanced)
ports.note: 1x analog unbalanced stereo audio, AC-coupled, RCA female, via breakout cable.

ports.name: Analog Audio Out (Balanced)
ports.note: 1x balanced analog stereo audio, XLR male, via breakout cable.

ports.name: Talkback Audio In
ports.note: Analog unbalanced stereo talkback/IFB input, AC-coupled mini-jack, via breakout cable.

ports.name: Talkback Audio Out
ports.note: Analog unbalanced stereo talkback/IFB output, AC-coupled mini-jack, via breakout cable.

ports.name: Power
ports.note: 20-50VDC wide-range DC input (22W typical consumption). Rear-panel diagram shows a round locking connector; exact connector series is not named in the datasheet — approximated as a 4-pin XLR-style DC connector, low confidence on this specific port.
